page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-highmem-384 is a high-capacity server instance within the c4d family. It features an x86_64 CPU architecture with 384 dedicated virtual central processing units and 3024.0 GB of system memory. This configuration yields approximately 7.88 GB of RAM per core, positioning it for memory-intensive workloads that require substantial concurrent processing power.

This server type does not include integrated graphics processing units or local storage drives, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external network-attached storage options. Additionally, the instance does not come with complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given its massive resource allocation of 384 dedicated vCPUs and over three terabytes of RAM, this instance represents a high-density hardware profile. It is designed for large-scale enterprise applications, massive in-memory databases, heavy data processing pipelines, and complex simulations that demand extensive memory capacity alongside high-core parallel execution without the need for local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration.
